note: Modern campground of Waterloo Recreation Area (Michigan DNR) on Big Portage Lake, off Seymour Road (11500 Seymour Road, Grass Lake, per the DNR directions), in three loops (north, central, south) on gently rolling ground under a tree canopy; paved pads with grass. The designated swim area, beach house and playground are down a paved path in the day-use area, with an 18-hole disc golf course. Camper cabin and two tiny houses. Recycling available. --Claude
